name.zh: 检查器渐进式控制披露

intent: 在参数密集的 Inspector 中保持主要动作和高频基础参数可见，将低频高级参数按语义组折叠/分区，避免一条无限增长的同级参数墙。
use_when: 主预览或主对象应保持视觉主导
do_not_use_when: 全部参数同等高频且数量很少
折叠会隐藏完成当前任务所必需的关键状态

interaction_contract.primary_actions: remain before/above the long parameter stack
interaction_contract.advanced: advanced groups are explicitly disclosed rather than permanently occupying equal hierarchy
interaction_contract.identity: control IDs and domain semantics remain stable when regrouped
interaction_contract.responsive: grouping survives tablet/mobile reflow without duplicating controls

visual_contract.hierarchy: primary actions > basic groups > advanced groups
visual_contract.wide: inspector may be sticky while its internal content scrolls
visual_contract.narrow: single-column flow restores normal document reachability

constraints: Regrouping must not create duplicate implementations.
Critical completion/save/generate actions must not disappear below a long advanced stack.
Responsive reflow changes presentation, not control ownership.
